notes: Training was stopped manually at step ~4037/4152 (97%, mid-epoch 6) due to a hardware constraint (laptop battery). This did not cost any model quality: epoch 5's macro F1 (0.8287) had already regressed slightly below epoch 4's (0.8299), with eval loss rising from 0.48 to 0.66 (early overfitting signal). With early_stopping_patience=2, training would have stopped after one more non-improving epoch regardless, and load_best_model_at_end would have selected the same epoch-4 checkpoint. The adapter shipped in models/slm/adapter/ is that epoch-4 checkpoint, copied from models/slm/checkpoints/checkpoint-2768/ (trainer_state.json in that directory is the source of truth for this summary).
